prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1103; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness. Over seven visits the patient received manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program, following a typical course for a lumbar strain. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as symptoms settled. Examination findings included paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion, which are consistent with the mechanism and force of the collision. Neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in the lower extremities, remained within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury to the lumbar region. Billing records show two similar charges submitted on the same day, which are currently under review. Based on the clinical course, the reported injury is consistent with the collision described, and discharge from active care is anticipated pending final re-examination.
